headline_stat.name: fraction of excitatory CA1 units classified as place cells (shuffle p<0.05)

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki dorsal CA1, 1.6 m linear track) is the canonical place-cell dataset, an expert's obvious choice.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed from S3 with a documented, duration-verified fix for the inverted SpatialSeries rate attribute, plus defensible excitatory/≥50-spike/speed>5cm-s selection.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information with a proper 200-iteration circular time-shift null is the standard, correct method, though linear-track directions were pooled rather than split.
justification.correctness: Reported numbers reproduce from the committed code and are internally consistent across README, figure titles, and the bar plot; p=0.005 is the correct floor for 200 shuffles.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show single place fields, a track-tiling population sequence, and observed-vs-null separation, with labeled axes, units, and genuinely representative top examples.
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and examples are real top cells, but the write-up states no result-specific limitation (single session, high 90% fraction, direction pooling), capping a clean result at 3.
justification.verdict: A correct, well-documented, reproducible demonstration of the canonical phenomenon that a rotation student could hand in with only minor requested additions.
